entries.target: A short range attack that deals damage to yourself.
entries.officialDescription: Summons an undead minion to your side (only appears if summoned outside of combat). Applies Grim Fate, a 4 second self DoT. Also damages yourself to send your minion into a Grim Frenzy, increasing your outgoing damage by 50% for 12 seconds, stacks to 3.
notes: Grim Frenzy increases Outgoing Damage up to 200%. First stack is 50%, second stack is 100% and last stack is 50%.
Summon cannot be summoned while in combat.
Summon cannot be summoned if a pet is equipped.
